params.name: billedMonth
params.description: The billing month in YYYY-MM format (e.g., 2025-03).

items.docs: Returns the organization's billing summary for the specified month in YYYY-MM format. Includes an overview of total charges, a breakdown by project, and a breakdown by service type such as compute, storage, and data transfer.

info.name: Get monthly bill with daily details

params.name: billedMonth
params.description: The billing month in YYYY-MM format (e.g., 2025-03).

items.docs: Returns the organization's detailed billing information for the specified month, broken down by daily usage per project, cluster, and service path. Includes credits applied, discounts, running totals, and total costs.

Returns usage cost details based on a custom cost explorer query. Supports filtering and grouping by project, cluster, service, region, and date range. Use this endpoint to build custom billing dashboards and spending trend reports.
